requirement: Define the primary endpoint as vasopressor- and mechanical-ventilator-free days through Day 30, assigning zero to any participant who dies within 30 days.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the endpoint and mortality penalty.

requirement: Estimate treatment benefit using the prespecified joint framework that models 30 minus P&VFD among survivors with a negative-binomial component and mortality with a binary component; report an interpretable overall P&VFD treatment effect and uncertainty.
